$comment: Copy to <project>/.opencode/team-dashboard.json (optional). Resolution per key: this file over ~/.config/opencode/team-dashboard.json (installation defaults) over built-ins. mode: ask = the team asks once per run when a user is present (headless runs skip silently); always = start every run, works under --auto (no question needed); never = off. refresh: seconds between regenerations; open_browser: open the dashboard on start; port: FIXED localhost port for serve mode (default 4731; already-occupied = hard error naming the holder, never silent re-allocation); coverage_ttl: seconds to cache a go-test coverage run (0 = off, default — a dashboard tick must not run tests / race the tester agent; failures cache at 5x ttl).
